authority.source: User-approved minimalist replacement, recorded from shipped CSS and components
authority.context: Focused code-led design; bundled Impeccable launcher unavailable. No human ten-second usability study claimed.

layout.scrolling: normal document flow at every width; no fixed-height desktop proof pane
layout.welcome: max-width 1240px; 1.25fr 1fr; gap 64px, 90px at >=1700px, 32px at <=1300px, 30px at <=1100px; single column, max-width 620px and gap 35px at <=850px
layout.workbench: minmax(300px, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1.4fr); 20px gap; second fraction 1.3fr and gap16px at <=1300px; stacks at <=850px
layout.register: sticky top24px; internal list max-height580px; static and list350px at <=850px
layout.tables: horizontal scroll; invoice/journal min-width575px; source min-width850px
layout.drawers: 100dvh, overflow-y:auto; ordinary540px, composer min(1080px,100%); max-width100%; sticky heading and composer submit strip

extensions.focus: 2px solid var(--blue); outline-offset4px; buttons, links, fields and summary elements

states.welcome: Empty workbench only: headline, explanation, Build a live case, Import CSV files, separate synthetic sample and three-step guide
states.staged: One source dataset may be imported before its counterpart; run when both exist
states.loaded: Three business outcomes, journal status/variance, register and proof inspector; balanced status requires at least one match, all-unmatched runs say No journal generated, staged inputs say Awaiting calculation
states.technicalDetails: Measured nodes/time only inside Solver details and Search & ranking details disclosures
states.pending: Explicit previous-run warning after edits; stale exports disabled
states.composer: Grouped customer/invoice/payment inputs, optional remittance and amount helpers; sticky submit strip remains within drawer viewport

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-primary { background:#a8ceff; color:#102138; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:8px; padding:9px 14px; min-height:40px; font:600 14px/1.35 Inter,Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .16s,border-color .16s; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#c3ddff; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #9ac6ff; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary { background:#1b2533; color:#f2f4f8; border:1px solid #3a485e; border-radius:8px; padding:9px 14px; min-height:40px; font:500 14px/1.35 Inter,Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .16s,border-color .16s; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:#263448; border-color:#60718c; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #9ac6ff; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Text field
components.css: .ds-field { background:#0f1621; color:#f2f4f8; border:1px solid #42516a; border-radius:7px; padding:11px 12px; font:15px/1.4 Inter,Arial,sans-serif; caret-color:#9ac6ff; } .ds-field::placeholder { color:#a0adbf; opacity:1; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #9ac6ff; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Navigation item
components.description: Labeled desktop navigation becomes an icon rail.
components.css: .ds-nav { background:#24344a; color:#c9e0ff; border:0; border-radius:8px; padding:12px; min-height:40px; text-align:left; font:500 14px/1.35 Inter,Arial,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav:hover { background:#202b3b; color:#f2f4f8; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #9ac6ff; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: State badge
components.description: Compact accounting status, expressed in text.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; padding:3px 7px; border:1px solid #53775e; border-radius:4px; color:#8ed6ad; font:500 12px/1.5 Inter,Arial,sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Welcome guide
components.description: Three-step explanation beside the first action.
components.html:
From payment to proof.

Add the payment. See what matches. Review every cent.
components.css: .ds-guide { background:#151c27; color:#f2f4f8; border:1px solid #2a3545; border-radius:14px; padding:32px; font:14px/1.65 Inter,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-guide h2 { margin:0; font-size:22px; font-weight:500; } .ds-guide p { color:#b0bac8; margin:8px 0 0; }

components.name: Solver disclosure
components.description: Technical timing is available on demand.
components.html:
Solver details

Measured Python execution and actual search nodes appear here after reconciliation.
components.css: .ds-details { color:#b0bac8; font:12px/1.5 Inter,Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-details summary { cursor:pointer; } .ds-details[open] summary { color:#9ac6ff; } .ds-details summary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #9ac6ff; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-details p { background:#202c3c; border:1px solid #53647d; border-radius:10px; padding:18px; }

narrative.overview: User-approved minimalist redesign replaces the cramped terminal while retaining charcoal/slate, Inter, IBM Plex Mono, and exact financial proof. Business outcomes and the first action lead; measured technical depth is disclosed progressively.
